calculatingSubtitle: Finding the most accurate direction for you
calibrationNeeded: Calibrate compass: move your phone in a figure-8
tip1Desc: You get the most accurate result when holding it parallel to the ground.
tip2Desc: When the angle reaches 0°, you've found the Qibla direction.
tip3Desc: Metal objects, electronic devices, and cars may affect the compass.
distanceToKaaba: You are {{distance}} km away from the Kaaba
hadith: "Wherever you are, turn your face toward the Sacred Mosque."

locationRequired.title: Location Needed
locationRequired.desc: The Qibla direction is calculated from your location. Grant location permission to see the correct direction.

sensorMissing.title: Compass Sensor Not Found
sensorMissing.subtitle: Hardware Limitation
sensorMissing.reasonDesc: Location services must be enabled for the compass to work. Once location is turned on, this screen will become active.
sensorMissing.alternativeDesc: You can see the direction to the Kaaba from your location on a map.
sensorMissing.hadith: "To Allah belongs the east and the west. Wherever you turn, there is the Face of Allah."
sensorMissing.openSettingsDesc: Turn on location and try again.
sensorMissing.permissionReason: The compass can't work without location permission
sensorMissing.permissionReasonDesc: True north is calculated from your location. Enable location permission in Settings and try again.
